title: OPOR-Bench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Online Public Opinion Report Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the absolute score distributions (e.g., medians and variance) assigned by different LLM evaluators (DeepSeek-V3 vs. GPT-4o) on identical reports to identify inherent strictness or lenience in LLM-as-a-judge frameworks.

Comparing the evaluation scores an LLM agent assigns to its own generated reports ('Self-Evaluation') versus reports generated by other models ('Cross-Evaluation') to measure for self-preference or self-criticism.
